_comment: Headline coverage figures: the only file to edit for them. The homepage, docs/coverage and llms.txt read it at build time. A value left as its own {{NAME}} token renders as a visible placeholder; `npm run build` warns, and `npm run check:figures` fails, while any is left. A value of null hides the figure: the homepage drops the block marked <!-- figure:NAME --> for it, and docs pages render it only where shown(NAME) allows; used anywhere else, it still renders as its {{NAME}} token. Each NAME_PCT also yields NAME_PCT_WHOLE, the share rounded to a whole percent, for the homepage.
_sources: The syntax figures come from the Snowflake coverage summary on main, `syntax-coverage summary --evidence <pinned evidence>/syntax/snowflake`, which counts the catalogue against the pinned cases and receipts and the review records in coverage/syntax/reviews. `make website-figures-update` writes SYNTAX_VERIFIED, SYNTAX_FORMS, SYNTAX_PCT and SYNTAX_BASIS from it, and `make website-figures`, part of check-ci, fails while they differ. SYNTAX_FORMS is that count's denominator and SYNTAX_PCT its verified share, with SYNTAX_VERIFIED the verified count. The translation figures are hidden (null) until their definition is decided.
SYNTAX_BASIS: 3,199 forms verified against cases recorded on Snowflake and approved reviews, as of 16 November 2026.
